profile.summary: Integral Group was a building engineering and consulting firm based in Oakland, California, focused on sustainable design. In 2022 it combined with Ross & Baruzzini under the new brand Introba, which offers plumbing, mechanical, electrical and fire protection engineering and sustainability consulting.
